title: Decennial
summary: DECEN'NIAL, adjective [Latin as above.] Continuing for ten years; consisting of ten years; or happening every ten years; as a decennial period; decennial games.

inlines.v: DECEN'NIAL, adjective [Latin as above.] Continuing for ten years; consisting of ten years; or happening every ten years; as a decennial period; decennial games.
